message.content:
If you want **MSNBC live streaming free online**, the most legitimate option in the results is the **MS NOW app** and **YouTube TV free trial**, while several third-party sites claim to stream it for free but are not official sources.[7][3][1]

- **Official/legit option:** The MS NOW app says you can watch live news and stream shows on demand **when signed in with your TV provider**.[7]
- **Free trial option:** YouTube TV lists **MSNBC Live** and offers a **free trial**.[3]
- **Unofficial free streams:** Sites like USNewsON, LivenewsNow, UFREETV, and FreeInterTV claim to offer free MSNBC live streams, but these are third-party sites rather than the network’s official service.[1][2][4][6]
- **Audio-only option:** MSNBC’s radio stream is available on radio.net, but that is **radio**, not video TV streaming.[5]

If you want, I can help you find the **best legal free way** to watch MSNBC based on your country and whether you need **live video**, **clips**, or **audio only**.
